actions.command:
for id in customer-alpha-73c customer-beta-a19; do
  v1val=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/$id)
  v2val=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8082/records/$id)
  echo "$id: v1=[$v1val] v2=[$v2val] match=$( [ "$v1val" = "$v2val" ] && echo yes || echo NO )"
done

actions.command:
cd /var/lib/rollout
# start background monitor hitting the public proxy during cutover
( for i in $(seq 1 200); do
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/version)
    echo "$i:$code"
    sleep 0.02
  done ) > /tmp/monitor.log &
MONPID=$!
sleep 0.3
echo "8082" > /var/lib/rollout/upstream.tmp
mv /var/lib/rollout/upstream.tmp /var/lib/rollout/upstream
wait $MONPID
sort /tmp/monitor.log | uniq -c -f1 | awk -F: '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c
grep -v ":200" /tmp/monitor.log || echo "all 200"

cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream; echo
echo "--- public endpoint now ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/version; echo
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health; echo
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c; echo
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-beta-a19; echo
echo "--- write a new record through proxy ---"
curl -s -X PUT --data "hello-v2" http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/newrec -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/newrec; echo
